title: Better Mob Combat - Reimagined
description: An add-on mod to Better Combat that allows it to work with (humanoid) mobs.
body:
# Better Mob Combat: Reimagined

Bring **Better Combat** to hostile humanoid mobs.

Better Mob Combat: Reimagined is a NeoForge 1.21.1 continuation of the original **Better Mob Combat**, bringing Better Combat's weapon-based combat system to Minecraft's humanoid mobs.

Instead of using vanilla's simple instant melee attacks, mobs now attack using the actual weapon they're holding, complete with animated swings, weapon reach, attack timing, and directional hitboxes.

***

## Features

![Husk](https://i.imgur.com/yclhKhd.png)

*   Humanoid mobs use Better Combat weapon attacks.
*   Mobs swing swords, axes, and other compatible weapons with proper attack animations.
*   Weapon reach respects the equipped weapon instead of using vanilla melee distance.
*   Directional weapon hitboxes replace vanilla "touch to damage" combat.
*   Attack timing is synchronized with swing animations, making enemy attacks more readable and fair.
*   Supports vanilla humanoid mobs, including:
    *   Zombies
    *   Husks
    *   Drowned
    *   Zombie Villagers
    *   Vindicators
    *   Piglins
    *   Piglin Brutes
    *   Other compatible humanoid mobs
*   Entity blacklist for disabling Better Combat on specific entities.
*   Extensive configuration options to customize combat behavior.

***

## Compatibility

Designed to work alongside:

*   Better Combat
*   Player Animator
*   Entity Model Features (EMF)
*   Entity Texture Features (ETF)
*   Fresh Animations
*   Fresh Animations : Player Extension

***

## Requirements

This mod requires:

*   [Better Combat](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/better-combat-by-daedelus)
*   Works on latest versions of Better Combat!

***

## Planned Features

*   Support for additional humanoid mobs from popular mods.
*   Improved compatibility with animation and model replacement mods.
*   Expanded configuration options.
*   Continued combat timing and animation refinements.
*   Ongoing bug fixes and performance improvements.
*   Fabric? - yes, this is planned.

***

## Credits

Better Mob Combat: Reimagined is a **NeoForge 1.21.1 continuation and modernization** of the original **Better Mob Combat** by **Thelnfamous1**.

The goal of this project is to preserve the original gameplay while updating it for modern Minecraft versions, improving compatibility, and continuing development.
